name: Oliver Hundslund
notes: ["Wields the Bow of Eurytus, a palítonos (\"bent backwards\") composite (made with horn, wood, and sinew) bow created by Apollo for Eurytus of Oechalia.","Named by Autolycus, his grandfather and a son of Hermes. He was a master thief capable of shapeshifting and invisibility."]

name: Mathilde Hirschfeld
notes: ["Very motherly but appears cold and intimidating.","Adores her children and spends time with all of them.","Might be Sunnilde's surrogate aunt.","Partially blinds Radulf for wronging Jolánta.","Does not get along with Falko.","Might like swords despite not being a swordsman."]

name: Bleddyn Ladrini
notes: ["As a son of Hermes, he was a master thief blessed with shapeshifting and invisibility."]

name: Turul Lovassy
notes: ["May be Endre I's eldest child, but he is not an heir.","May have a crush on Eszter, but it is unrequited."]
